window-1.title: Poolsuite FM
window-1.blurb: It's an entire sun-bleached 90s computer desktop that plays endless summer radio — the kind of committed-to-the-bit web world you'll want to steal interface ideas from while it scores your next side quest.

window-2.title: Tedium: The Dull Side of the Internet
window-2.blurb: It goes absurdly deep on the unglamorous stuff — dead software, forgotten gadgets, weird old fonts — and every issue reads like a side quest someone left out for you to pick up.

window-3.title: Spiced Tamarind Mocktail
window-3.blurb: Sour, salty, gingery chaat energy in a glass — it's the rare mocktail that tastes like a snack stall instead of a juice bar, and the kala namak makes it weirdly addictive.

window-4.title: An Epic Use of Glass Blocks (Sight Unseen)

window-5.title: Behind Clay — the hidden room behind the pizza oven
window-5.blurb: There's no sign and no door — you walk straight through a riverside pizzeria, past the wood-fired oven, into a secret 52-seat lounge serving mala pork belly out of a paper bag and foie gras pizza with tamarind, which feels like a place built specifically for you to show up overdressed and make an entire night of it.
